name: Composio
tagline: Many apps through your own Composio link
description: Composio connects agents to Gmail, Slack, GitHub, and hundreds of other apps through one MCP server. Create the server in your Composio account, add the apps you want to it, and paste its link here. Add an API key only if your server requires one.

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email and draft replies to the urgent ones.
Post a summary of this pull request to our team channel.
Which apps and actions can you use through Composio?
